Once your order has shipped, it is generally not possible to change the delivery address directly through us. However, there are a few options depending on the shipping carrier:
For UPS shipments, you can use the UPS My Choice service to manage delivery preferences, such as temporarily holding packages, scheduling redelivery, or arranging pickup from a UPS location. This may offer some flexibility if you need to reroute or adjust delivery details.
For USPS shipments, you can make certain requests through your local Post Office to manage the shipment.
If your order is already en route and cannot be canceled, you may request a re-route so the shipment is returned to us instead of being delivered to your original address. Please note that shipping fees may not be refundable in these cases, and additional return fees could apply, especially for mattresses or large items.
